title: fix(console): a refused form submit says a localized sentence, never the server's response body
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"zhuangjianguo"} -->
_Requested by **Steedos** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9Ubb?thread=cmsg_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9UbbFRxphhoFxVrLjWvErpd4Ep)_

Fixes #29019

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**:控制台表单页(`/forms/NAME`、应用内表单、公开 `/f/SLUG`)提交被拒时,横幅和 toast 不再显示服务端原始 JSON,改为与记录对话框同一套读法:无权限显示本地化的「您没有权限保存这条记录。」,5xx 显示本地化的「保存失败,请重试。」,其他 4xx 显示服务端信封里的那句话;字段标记照旧。
- **为什么改**:没有创建权限的成员打开表单链接提交后,看到的是英文的 `Create failed (403): {"error":…,"code":"PERMISSION_DENIED","object":…}`,连对象机器名都露出来了。
- **风险与回滚**:只动 `FormPage.tsx` 的拒绝文案读取;没有新增 i18n 键(复用十个语言包里已有的 `form.noPermissionToSave` / `form.submitFailed`)。回滚即还原此 PR。
- **先看**:`ui/apps/console/src/components/FormPage.tsx` 的 `WriteRefusal` 与 `refusalText`;`FormPage.refusalText-29019.test.tsx`。
- **两分钟验证**:`cd ui && pnpm exec vitest run apps/console/src/components/FormPage.refusalText-29019.test.tsx`,预期 7 个用例全绿。
- **需要你做的**:无,席位落地。

## What changes

`ui/apps/console/src/components/FormPage.tsx` only (plus its tests and a changeset):

- **The thrown refusal no longer carries the body as its text.** `refusedWriteError(message, body)` is replaced by a page-local `WriteRefusal` error that attaches the response the way `@objectstack/client` does: `status`, `code`, `details` (the wrapped envelope's `error.details`, else the whole flat body) and the producer-marked `userMessage` from either dialect. Its message is the server's own sentence (the envelope's `error`, the wrapped `error.message`, or a plain-text body), never the body itself; the raw body stays on `.body` for a debugger.
- **The banner and the toast say one sentence, read the way the record dialog reads it** (`@object-ui/components`' form renderer, same `@object-ui/react` readers, same order):
  1. a producer-marked `userMessage`, or a delegated administrator's scope refusal, as written;
  2. any other denial (`403`, `PERMISSION_DENIED`, `FORBIDDEN`) as `form.noPermissionToSave` ("You don't have permission to save this record.");
  3. the per-rule lines no input carries (`unmarkedRefusalLines`), as before;
  4. the server's sentence for any other `4xx`;
  5. a `5xx`, or a refusal with no sentence (a proxy's markup page), as `form.submitFailed` ("Could not save. Please try again.").
- **Field markers are unchanged**: `extractFieldErrors` reads the same `code`/`details` it read before.
- **No new i18n key.** Both lines already exist in all ten packs (ar, de, en, es, fr, ja, ko, pt, ru, zh), so `Clause-②: no` holds by construction and no pack changes.

## Why

A member with read but no create right on an object opened its form link, pressed Submit, and read `Create failed (403): {"error":"You do not have permission to perform this action. …","code":"PERMISSION_DENIED","object":"qar8_fsb"}` verbatim, in English, on the banner and the toast. The record dialog already says the localized denial for the same refusal.

## Tests

- New `FormPage.refusalText-29019.test.tsx` (7 cases): the QA run's 403 `PERMISSION_DENIED` create on the internal route reads the localized denial on the banner and the toast, identical, with no `{`, no status code and no `failed (`; the same in `zh` (`您没有权限保存这条记录。`); the dispatcher's wrapped 403 on the public route; a producer-marked `userMessage` said as written; a 400 `VALIDATION_FAILED` with `fields[]` still marks its field and says the server's sentence; a 500 reads the generic line and not the driver text; a 502 markup page reads the generic line.
- Two older pins asserted the raw text (`Submit failed (400)`) and now assert the server's sentence: `FormPage.refusalMarks-27417.test.tsx` (the banner/toast pin of the first case) and `FormPage.nativeInvalid-27496.test.tsx`.
- **Ablation** (`scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, anchor `? refusalText(err, unmarked, t)` x1 -> x0, replaced by the old `… failed (STATUS): BODY` text): the new suite went **7/7 red**; restored, blob equals HEAD and `git diff HEAD` is empty.

## Acceptance notes

- **Up-front refusal: not done, measured.** The in-app route `/apps/:appName/forms/:name` renders under `ConsolePermissionsScope` (`App.tsx` pathless layout around `/home` and `/apps/:appName/*`), so it already holds the caller's `/me/permissions` answer. The app-less `/forms/:name` route of the reproduction is outside that scope (`App.tsx`, the `/forms/:name` route under `ProtectedRoute` alone), so knowing the create right there needs a new request; the public `/f/:slug` is anonymous. Doing it on one route only would make the same form behave differently by URL, so it is reported to the seat as a finding instead.
- The record-load failure on an edit form (`Could not open record … (STATUS): DETAIL`, the load path, not the submit) still appends the response body; it is outside this card's ruling (the submit/create/update messages) and is reported to the seat.
